title: mods of games here good? i made a couple Balatro mods with the assistance of AI focused on vanilla-friendly content and counteracting mod difficulty dilution
author: ContactIcy3963
selftext:
Hello all. I created a few Balatro mods with help from Claude to enhance my vanilla Balatro experience. Ultimately I was inspired to make these mods to expand specifically the vanilla-side of the game without adding too much extra content that break beyond a "vanilla" playthrough.

I don't have much coding experience outside of what I do for finance work so Claude was a good entry way for me to migrate my creativity into my video game hobbies. Given that, my goal was to keep the caliber of the above "handwritten" modded content and I hope that the final releases will feel that way (I've had Claude point out and fix several bugs in other modders' mods so I really don't want to hear how coding just by hand is better these days).

[https://github.com/plaxerx/MoarStakesPlease](https://github.com/plaxerx/MoarStakesPlease) \--> higher stakes above gold for mod creep / gold is easy folk  
[https://github.com/plaxerx/MoarChallengesPlease](https://github.com/plaxerx/MoarChallengesPlease) \--> 30 more challenges on top of the 20 that game with the game  
[https://github.com/plaxerx/pinochle](https://github.com/plaxerx/pinochle) \--> sandbox game modes just for fun  
[https://github.com/plaxerx/erraticmode](https://github.com/plaxerx/erraticmode) \--> Balatro randomizer game mode with some twists

Looking for feedback and bug identification who are passionate about Balatro as well as utilizing AI to augment content creation, especially for ErraticMode, and hope these can serve as a few examples of where AI can help you create the game content you can't otherwise find!
